en.description: Main concerns it treats: A personalised, science-led approach to your hormonal health. faq.q: What is a Menopause & Hormone Assessment?
faq.a:
This is a comprehensive medical consultation focused on identifying hormonal imbalances and supporting you through every stage of menopause.
Hormone levels — including oestrogen, progesterone and testosterone — naturally fluctuate during this time, often leading to symptoms such as hot flushes, anxiety, sleep disturbance and low mood .
Our goal is to assess these changes, understand your symptoms, and create a personalised treatment plan that supports your long-term health.

faq.q: What does the treatment involve?
faq.a:
Your journey always starts with a conversation.
During your consultation, we will:
Take a detailed medical and lifestyle history
Explore your symptoms and concerns in depth
Arrange targeted blood testing (if appropriate)
Review hormone levels and key health markers
Discuss evidence-based treatment options
Create a personalised care plan
Where suitable, this may include hormone replacement therapy (HRT), which can be highly effective in managing symptoms and supporting overall wellbeing .

faq.q: What can we help with?
faq.a:
Hot flushes and night sweats
Low mood, anxiety, or brain fog
Sleep disturbance and fatigue
Weight changes
Low libido
Joint aches and reduced energy
Irregular or changing periods
Our approach
We take a holistic, patient-centred approach to menopause care.
This means:
No one-size-fits-all treatments
Time to listen and understand your experience
A balance of medical expertise and lifestyle support
Ongoing follow-up and optimisation

faq.q: Is this treatment right for me?
faq.a:
This service is ideal if you:
Think you may be perimenopausal or menopausal
Are struggling with unexplained symptoms
Want clarity around your hormone health
Are considering or already using HRT
Want a proactive, preventative approach to ageing well
Your next step
Book your consultation today and take control of your hormonal health with expert guidance and personalised care.

faq.q: What is a Health MOT?
faq.a: A Health MOT is an in-depth review of your overall health, combining medical insight with personalised lifestyle recommendations.

faq.q: Why is this important?
faq.a:
Research suggests that up to 80% of many common chronic diseases - particularly cardiovascular disease, stroke, and type 2 diabetes - may be preventable through changes in lifestyle and environment. It raises an important question: what can we be doing now to give ourselves the best chance of long-term health and a high quality of life?
Chronic diseases are conditions that tend to develop gradually over time, often shaped by everyday factors such as nutrition, physical activity, sleep, and stress.

faq.q: What does the consultation involve?
faq.a:
Your consultation includes:
A doctor-led consultation taking a proactive, personalised approach to your health.
A detailed discussion of your medical history and lifestyle, exploring what’s working well and where meaningful changes could be made.
Assessment of your current health using measures such as blood pressure and heart rate.
Body composition scanning where appropriate.
Analysis of key health markers and appropriate risk stratification.
Personalised interpretation of your results.
A tailored health and wellbeing plan.
Guidance on appropriate blood testing and blood test interpretation (where required, blood tests are an additional fee).

faq.q: Why choose a Health MOT?
faq.a:
Support healthy ageing
Gain clarity and reassurance
Optimise energy, mood and performance
Our approach
Here, at Espacio, we believe health goes beyond managing disease. It’s about optimising how you feel physically and mentally today, and using best available evidence to optimise how you’ll feel in the next 10, 20, and 30 years.

faq.q: What are dermal fillers?
faq.a: Dermal fillers are injectable treatments designed to add volume, smooth out wrinkles, and enhance facial contours. They’re made from hyaluronic acid, which naturally occurs in the skin, helping to restore a youthful appearance.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with dermal fillers?
faq.a: Dermal fillers can be used in various areas of the face, including the lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, and around the mouth (for smile lines and marionette lines). They can also be used on the hands to restore volume.

faq.q: How long do dermal fillers last?
faq.a: The results of dermal fillers typically last between 6 to 18 months, depending on the type of filler used and the area treated. Over time, the body naturally breaks down the filler, so maintenance treatments are needed to sustain the results.

faq.q: Is there any downtime?
faq.a: There’s minimal downtime with dermal fillers. You might experience some swelling, redness, or bruising at the injection site, but these side effects usually subside within a few days. Most people return to their daily activities the following day.

faq.q: When will I see results?
faq.a: Results from dermal fillers are visible almost immediately, with full effects typically seen within a few days once any swelling has gone down.

faq.q: What is the Nefertiti Neck Lift?

Named after the Egyptian queen famed for her elegant neckline, the Nefertiti Neck Lift is a popular choice for patients looking for natural, non-surgical facial rejuvenation.

en.target: Target Area: eyes, neck & decollete
en.description: Main concerns it treats: skin tags & warts, seborrheic keratosis Plasmage is a non-invasive treatment that uses plasma energy to safely and precisely remove benign lesions like warts, skin tags, and seborrheic keratosis without the need for surgical incisions.

faq.q: What is Plasmage and how does it work?
faq.a: Plasmage is a non-invasive treatment that uses plasma energy to treat various skin concerns, like eyelid tightening (blepharoplasty), wrinkles and skin lesions. The device ionises gases in the air to create a small plasma arc, which vaporises the outer layers of the skin without damaging the surrounding tissue, promoting regeneration and tightening.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with Plasmage?
faq.a: Plasmage is commonly used for non-surgical eyelid lifts (blepharoplasty), treating wrinkles around the eyes and mouth. It can also aid the removal of skin tags, warts and seborrhoeic keratosis making it versatile for different skin concerns.

faq.q: How long does the treatment take and is there any downtime?
faq.a: A Plasmage session typically lasts 25 to 45 minutes, depending on the area being treated. There is minimal downtime, but you may experience slight redness, swelling, and scabbing in the treated area for 7 days as the skin heals. Avoid picking at the scabs to ensure the treatment heals effectively.

faq.q: Is Plasmage painful?
faq.a: Most people find the treatment to be well-tolerated. A local anaethetic or numbing cream is applied before the procedure to minimise discomfort, and any sensation felt is usually mild and similar to a tingling or slight burning feeling.

faq.q: How long do the results last, and how many treatments are needed?
faq.a: Results from Plasmage are long-lasting, often visible after one session, and continue to improve as the skin heals. Depending on the treatment area and your skin’s condition, you may need 2 sessions to achieve the desired result.

faq.q: What is Poly-Needling?
faq.a: Polynucleotides, derived from DNA fragments, are introduced into the skin during micro-needling to accelerate natural healing processes and promote cell regeneration. This innovative approach targets fine lines, wrinkles, acne scars, and uneven texture while boosting hydration and skin vitality. With the added benefits of Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid, skin is left immediately glowing.

faq.q: Who is Poly-Needling suitable for?
faq.a: This treatment is ideal for individuals looking to improve skin texture, elasticity, and hydration. It’s suitable for various skin types and can help with ageing, scarring, pigmentation, or overall skin rejuvenation.

faq.q: How long does a session take, and how many treatments will I need?
faq.a: A typical session lasts 45-60 minutes. For best results, we recommend a course of 3 treatments, 1 month apart. Maintenance sessions every 6 months can help prolong the effects.

faq.q: Are there any side effects or downtime?
faq.a: Mild redness, swelling or tightness may occur but these side effects usually subside within a few days. There is minimal downtime, and you can resume your normal activities shortly after treatment.

faq.q: How long do the results last?
faq.a: Results can last between 6 and 12 months, depending on your skin condition and lifestyle. Regular maintenance treatments can help sustain the benefits.

faq.q: What is Viscoderm?
faq.a: Viscoderm is a professional aesthetic treatment that involves injecting highly purified hyaluronic acid (HA) into the skin to improve hydration, elasticity, and skin tone. It helps rejuvenate the skin from within by stimulating collagen production.

faq.q: How does Viscoderm work?
faq.a: Viscoderm delivers hydration deep into the skin layers, which promotes natural regeneration. The hyaluronic acid in Viscoderm helps to retain moisture, giving the skin a plump, youthful appearance while reducing fine lines.

faq.q: Who is Viscoderm suitable for?
faq.a: Viscoderm is ideal for people looking to improve skin quality, reduce signs of ageing, or boost overall skin hydration. It can be used on the face, neck, décolletage, and hands and is suitable for various skin types.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with Viscoderm?
faq.a: Viscoderm is most commonly used on the face, but it’s also effective for treating the neck, chest, and hands—areas that often show signs of ageing and dehydration.

faq.q: How long does a Viscoderm treatment session take?
faq.a: A typical Viscoderm treatment session lasts about 30 to 45 minutes, depending on the areas being treated.

faq.q: What can I expect during the treatment?
faq.a: The treatment involves a series of small injections using very fine needles. You may feel mild discomfort, but most people find the treatment tolerable. Some practitioners use numbing cream to enhance comfort.

faq.q: How many treatments will I need?
faq.a: The number of sessions depends on your skin condition and goals, but typically, 2 to 3 treatments spaced 3 to 4 weeks apart are recommended for optimal results.

faq.q: Are there any side effects?
faq.a: After treatment, you may experience some redness, mild swelling, or bruising at the injection site. These effects are temporary and should subside within a few days.

faq.q: How soon will I see results?
faq.a: You may notice an improvement in your skin’s hydration and texture within a few days, but the full effects will develop over the weeks following your treatment.

faq.q: How long do the results last?
faq.a: Results typically last 4 to 6 months, after which a maintenance treatment may be recommended to preserve the benefits.

faq.q: Is there any downtime?
faq.a: There’s minimal downtime associated with Viscoderm. You can return to your normal activities immediately after the treatment, although it’s recommended to avoid strenuous exercise, alcohol, and excessive sun exposure for 24 hours.

faq.q: What is Profhilo®?
faq.a: Profhilo® is an injectable treatment that hydrates and tightens the skin. It’s a unique, non-invasive skin remodelling treatment made from hyaluronic acid, designed to improve skin laxity and boost overall skin quality. Unlike traditional dermal fillers, Profhilo® spreads evenly across the skin, delivering hydration and stimulating collagen and elastin production.

faq.q: How does Profhilo® work?
faq.a: Profhilo® contains a high concentration of hyaluronic acid, which is injected just beneath the skin’s surface. Once injected, it disperses evenly, hydrating the skin from within, and encouraging the production of collagen and elastin, which helps to firm and tighten the skin.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with Profhilo®?
faq.a: Profhilo® is most commonly used on the face, neck, décolletage, and hands. It’s ideal for areas where the skin is showing signs of ageing, such as fine lines, wrinkles, and sagging.

faq.q: How long do Profhilo® results last?
faq.a: The effects of Profhilo® can last up to 6 months, but this varies depending on factors like age, skin type, and lifestyle. For optimal results, an initial course of two treatments spaced four weeks apart is recommended, followed by maintenance treatments every 6 months.

faq.q: What should I expect during the treatment?
faq.a: The Profhilo® treatment involves a series of small injections into specific points on the treated area. The procedure is quick, usually taking about 15 to 30 minutes, and involves minimal discomfort. There’s no need for a numbing cream, although it can be applied if required.

faq.q: Is there any downtime with Profhilo®?
faq.a: Profhilo® has minimal downtime. You might experience some redness, swelling, or small bumps at the injection sites, but these typically subside within 24 hours. Most people return to their normal activities the following day.

faq.q: When will I see results?
faq.a: You may start to notice an improvement in your skin’s texture and hydration within a few days after treatment, with the full effects becoming more visible after 4 weeks. Skin will appear smoother, plumper, and more radiant.

faq.a: Profhilo® is an injectable treatment that hydrates and tightens the skin. It’s a unique, non-invasive skin remodelling treatment made from hyaluronic acid, designed to improve skin laxity and boost overall skin quality. Unlike traditional dermal fillers, Profhilo® spreads evenly across the skin, delivering hydration and stimulating collagen and elastin production.

faq.q: How does Profhilo® work?
faq.a: Profhilo® contains a high concentration of hyaluronic acid, which is injected just beneath the skin’s surface. Once injected, it disperses evenly, hydrating the skin from within, and encouraging the production of collagen and elastin, which helps to firm and tighten the skin.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with Profhilo®?
faq.a: Profhilo® is most commonly used on the face, neck, décolletage, and hands. It’s ideal for areas where the skin is showing signs of ageing, such as fine lines, wrinkles, and sagging.

faq.q: How long do Profhilo® results last?
faq.a: The effects of Profhilo® can last up to 6 months, but this varies depending on factors like age, skin type, and lifestyle. For optimal results, an initial course of two treatments spaced four weeks apart is recommended, followed by maintenance treatments every 6 months.

faq.q: What should I expect during the treatment?
faq.a: The Profhilo® treatment involves a series of small injections into specific points on the treated area. The procedure is quick, usually taking about 15 to 30 minutes, and involves minimal discomfort. There’s no need for a numbing cream, although it can be applied if you have sensitive skin.

faq.q: Is there any downtime with Profhilo®?
faq.a: Profhilo® has minimal downtime. You might experience some redness, swelling, or small bumps at the injection sites, but these typically subside within 24 hours. Most people return to their normal activities the following day.

faq.q: When will I see results?
faq.a: You may start to notice an improvement in your skin’s texture and hydration within a few days after treatment, with the full effects becoming more visible after 4 weeks. Skin will appear smoother, plumper, and more radiant.

This is a non-surgical treatment option for excessive sweating, otherwise known as hyperhidrosis. The affected area is injected with Botox which effectively blocks the nerve signals that cause perspiration from the sweat glands.

faq.q: What is Botox®?
faq.a: Botox® is an injectable neurotoxin that temporarily stops nerve signals reaching target muscles. It is used as a popular cosmetic treatment to reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles by temporarily relaxing the underlying muscles. It can also stop nerve signals reaching sweat glands, and can therefore be used in the non-surgical treatment of excessive sweating.

faq.q: What can I expect during the treatment?
faq.a: The Botox® procedure is quick and minimally invasive. A trained medical practitioner will use a fine needle to inject small amounts of Botox® into the target area. You might feel a slight pinch, but the discomfort is generally minimal. For hyperhidrosis treatment, the entire process usually takes about 20-30 minutes.

faq.q: Is there any downtime?
faq.a: There’s little to no downtime with Botox®. Most people return to their normal activities immediately after treatment. However, it’s best to avoid strenuous exercise, excessive heat, or rubbing the treated area for about 24 hours post-treatment to ensure the best results.

faq.q: How long will the treatment last?
faq.a: As with all Botox treatments, the effect is temporary but can last up to 6 months.

faq.q: What should I do after my Botox® treatment?
faq.a: Aftercare is simple. Avoid touching or massaging the treated areas for the rest of the day. Avoid any vigorous physical activity or excessive heat for the first 24 hours. You should also skip saunas, hot tubs, and intense facial treatments for a few days to ensure optimal results.

faq.q: What are dermal fillers?
faq.a: Dermal fillers are injectable treatments designed to add volume, smooth out wrinkles, and enhance facial contours. They’re made from hyaluronic acid, which naturally occurs in the skin, helping to restore a youthful appearance.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with dermal fillers?
faq.a: Dermal fillers can be used in various areas of the face, including the lips, cheeks, jawline, chin, and around the mouth (for smile lines and marionette lines). They can also be used on the hands to restore volume.

faq.q: How long do dermal fillers last?
faq.a: The results of dermal fillers typically last between 6 to 18 months, depending on the type of filler used and the area treated. Over time, the body naturally breaks down the filler, so maintenance treatments are needed to sustain the results.

faq.q: Is there any downtime?
faq.a: There’s minimal downtime with dermal fillers. You might experience some swelling, redness, or bruising at the injection site, but these side effects usually subside within a few days. Most people return to their daily activities the following day.

faq.q: When will I see results?
faq.a: Results from dermal fillers are visible almost immediately, with full effects typically seen within a few days once any swelling has gone down. You’ll notice smoother skin, added volume, and enhanced facial contours.

faq.q: What is Plasmage and how does it work?
faq.a: Plasmage is a non-invasive treatment that uses plasma energy to treat various skin concerns, like eyelid tightening (blepharoplasty), wrinkles and skin lesions. The device ionises gases in the air to create a small plasma arc, which vaporises the outer layers of the skin without damaging the surrounding tissue, promoting regeneration and tightening.

faq.q: What areas can be treated with Plasmage?

faq.q: How long does the treatment take and is there any downtime?

Avoid picking at the scabs to ensure the treatment heals effectively.

faq.q: Is Plasmage painful?

faq.q: How long do the results last, and how many treatments are needed?

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) Hair Therapy is a natural treatment that uses your own blood to promote hair growth. The process involves drawing a small amount of blood, which is then processed to concentrate the platelets. These platelets are rich in growth factors that help stimulate the hair follicles, encouraging hair growth and improving the thickness and health of your hair.

faq.q: What is PRP and how does it work?
faq.a:
PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) Hair Therapy is a clinically proven treatment for hair thinning and early hair loss. It works by harnessing the regenerative power of your own blood platelets, which are rich in growth factors. When carefully injected into the scalp, PRP helps to activate and nourish dormant hair follicles, encouraging stronger and denser hair growth over time.
This minimally invasive procedure is suitable for both men and women seeking to improve hair thickness, slow down hair loss, and boost overall scalp health.

faq.q: What are the benefits of PRP treatment?
faq.a: PRP uses your own DNA for a natural way to rejuvenate the skin, reduce fine lines, improve skin tone and texture, treat hair loss, and help with scar reduction. It’s popular for both facial rejuvenation and hair restoration.

faq.q: How is the PRP treatment done?
faq.a: A small amount of blood is drawn from you, processed to separate the platelet-rich plasma, and then injected into the targeted area. The entire process usually takes about 45 minutes to an hour.

faq.q: Is PRP safe, and are there any side effects?
faq.a: Since PRP uses your own blood, it is generally considered safe with minimal risk of allergic reactions or complications. Common side effects may include mild redness, swelling, or bruising at the injection site, which typically resolves within a few days.

faq.q: How long do the results of PRP last?
faq.a: Results from PRP treatment usually appear gradually over the course of several weeks and can last anywhere from 6 to 12 months, depending on the treatment area and your body's response. A course of treatments are requires and maintenance sessions may be recommended to sustain the results.
